request.prompt:
You are drafting introductions inside a private professional network. An
operator will read each one and decide whether to send it. Nothing you write is
sent automatically.

For each numbered pair, write:
  why           one sentence on why these two should meet
  a_gets        what person A gets, one short clause
  b_gets        what person B gets, one short clause
  draft_message a note the operator could send, UNDER 120 WORDS

RULES
- Use only what is given. Do not invent a company, a metric, a mutual friend or
  a shared history.
- Lead with the matched need and offer. That pairing is the reason for the
  introduction; everything else is decoration.
- Where the pair is marked reciprocal, say what each side gives. Where it is
  not, be honest that one side is doing the other a favour -- an operator needs
  to know which ask they are making.
- Address the draft to both people. Warm, brief, no exclamation marks, no
  "I hope this finds you well".

Return JSON:
{
  "$defs": {
    "IntroCopy": {
      "properties": {
        "pair": {
          "title": "Pair",
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "why": {
          "title": "Why",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "a_gets": {
          "title": "A Gets",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "b_gets": {
          "title": "B Gets",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "draft_message": {
          "description": "under 120 words",
          "title": "Draft Message",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "pair",
        "why",
        "a_gets",
        "b_gets",
        "draft_message"
      ],
      "title": "IntroCopy",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "intros": {
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/IntroCopy"
      },
      "title": "Intros",
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "intros"
  ],
  "title": "IntroCopyBatch",
  "type": "object"
}

PAIRS:
  pair 0:
    person_a: Gaurav Menon — Principal — Cadence Ventures Asia
    person_b: Pooja R. — Co-founder & COO (interim) — Cadence Logic
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: hiring a first India-based operator
    B offers: running India operations and local hiring
    B needs: getting founder-led distribution working consistently
    A offers: introductions into a network of growth-stage founders

  pair 1:
    person_a: Madhav Kim — Managing Director — Ridge & Co
    person_b: Varun Clarke — Product Manager — Cardinal Base Ltd
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: introductions to founders who need this kind of help
    B offers: helping founders make their first sales hires
    B needs: a rebrand before we go upmarket
    A offers: running technical leadership searches for consumer apps companies

  pair 2:
    person_a:  Prakash Chopra  — Corporate Counsel — Cipher Legal
    person_b: MEERA SILVA — CORPORATE COUNSEL — Mosaic Advisory Inc.
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: a steadier pipeline of seed-stage clients
    B offers: setting up analytics stacks for seed-stage companies
    B needs: positioning the practice so it stops competing on price
    A offers: repositioning international products for US buyers

  pair 3:
    person_a:  Rohia Zaidi  — Brand Strategist — Willow Collective
    person_b: Varun Goel — Partner — Lumen Growth Partners
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: introductions to founders who need this kind of help
    B offers: helping founders sharpen the seed narrative before they pitch
    B needs: automating internal ops work that eats the team's week
    A offers: building automated outbound systems that book meetings reliably
